# Resources

<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-START -->
<!-- A short orientation for this page; task guidance belongs under Use. Kept across regeneration. -->
Collection resources return JSON. The `tasks://paperless` resource returns the
first page of unacknowledged background tasks as a JSON array; use the
`list_tasks` tool for further pages or a filter.
<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-END -->

## Reading a resource

A resource is data this server serves at a URI, for a client to attach to the conversation rather than for the model to call. In Claude Code, mention one as `@<server>:<uri>`, where `<server>` is the name you gave this server when you added it; a resource template takes its parameters in the URI.

## `config_resource`

`config://paperless` (application/json)

The Paperless URL, public URL and default page size this server uses.

## `stats_resource`

`stats://paperless` (application/json)

Archive-wide counts: documents, inbox, tags, correspondents and types.

## `remote_version_resource`

`remote-version://paperless` (application/json)

The newest release of Paperless-NGX, not the version installed here, and whether it is newer.

## `tags_resource`

`tags://paperless` (application/json)

Every tag, with its id, name and colour.

## `correspondents_resource`

`correspondents://paperless` (application/json)

Every correspondent, with its id, name and the date of its newest document.

## `document_types_resource`

`document-types://paperless` (application/json)

Every document type, with its id and name.

## `custom_fields_resource`

`custom-fields://paperless` (application/json)

Every custom field definition, with its id, name and type.

## `storage_paths_resource`

`storage-paths://paperless` (application/json)

Every storage path, with its id, name and path template.

## `saved_views_resource`

`saved-views://paperless` (application/json)

Every saved view, with its id, name and filter rules.

## `tasks_resource`

`tasks://paperless` (application/json)

The newest unacknowledged background tasks, with their status.

## `document_resource`

`paperless://documents/{document_id}` (application/json)

A document's metadata, without its text.

Parameters: `document_id`.

## `document_content_resource`

`paperless://documents/{document_id}/content` (text/plain)

The first part of a document's text.

Parameters: `document_id`.

## `document_metadata_resource`

`paperless://documents/{document_id}/metadata` (application/json)

A document's file details: names, sizes, checksums and MIME type.

Parameters: `document_id`.

## `document_notes_resource`

`paperless://documents/{document_id}/notes` (application/json)

The notes on a document.

Parameters: `document_id`.

## `document_history_resource`

`paperless://documents/{document_id}/history` (application/json)

The change history of a document.

Parameters: `document_id`.

## `document_thumbnail_resource`

`paperless://documents/{document_id}/thumbnail` (image/png)

A small image of a document's first page.

Parameters: `document_id`.
